Finding him in this intention, I put on my own great-coat (but did not light my own cigar, having had enough of that for one while) and walked with him as far as the open road: a dull road, then, at night. He was in great spirits all the way; and when we parted, and I looked after him going so gallantly and airily homeward, I thought of his saying, ‘Ride on over all obstacles, and win the race!’ and wished, for the first time, that he had some worthy race to run.", "sha256": "4cfacd058ad8b8d7edcf926b49aab7b330f9b59632a2379680771b76e40529af", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[35]/p[158]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u030-b0158", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "I was undressing in my own room, when Mr. Micawber’s letter tumbled on the floor. Thus reminded of it, I broke the seal and read as follows. It was dated an hour and a half before dinner. I am not sure whether I have mentioned that, when Mr. Micawber was at any particularly desperate crisis, he used a sort of legal phraseology, which he seemed to think equivalent to winding up his affairs.", "sha256": "b0f8f31d910558441a845e1d65ad0ad34088b7a31e29a017326d1d88377ed5c8", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[35]/p[159]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u030-b0159", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘SIR—for I dare not say my dear Copperfield,", "sha256": "44b155509d193b15bc7b350ede03e85d3f89ed307bfcb5b9676773ea3a12c2f8", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[35]/p[160]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u030-b0160", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘It is expedient that I should inform you that the undersigned is Crushed. Some flickering efforts to spare you the premature knowledge of his calamitous position, you may observe in him this day; but hope has sunk beneath the horizon, and the undersigned is Crushed.", "sha256": "0a162cea43b5c7888064c21987b24e8fd849f83d7555ac4255509f0819b4b370", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[35]/p[161]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u030-b0161", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘The present communication is penned within the personal range (I cannot call it the society) of an individual, in a state closely bordering on intoxication, employed by a broker. That individual is in legal possession of the premises, under a distress for rent. His inventory includes, not only the chattels and effects of every description belonging to the undersigned, as yearly tenant of this habitation, but also those appertaining to Mr. Thomas Traddles, lodger, a member of the Honourable Society of the Inner Temple.", "sha256": "cf5076039cbc572bcde44fe3858340268e2d305b75cec8d9739a92137b604b74", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[35]/p[162]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u030-b0162", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘If any drop of gloom were wanting in the overflowing cup, which is now “commended” (in the language of an immortal Writer) to the lips of the undersigned, it would be found in the fact, that a friendly acceptance granted to the undersigned, by the before-mentioned Mr. Thomas Traddles, for the sum Of 23l 4s 9 1/2d is over due, and is NOT provided for. Also, in the fact that the living responsibilities clinging to the undersigned will, in the course of nature, be increased by the sum of one more helpless victim; whose miserable appearance may be looked for—in round numbers—at the expiration of a period not exceeding six lunar months from the present date.", "sha256": "14779b53c96a9bfe32d4c66c09193246acbb51cbe19db7331c8a7617fa8ee0ba", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[35]/p[163]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u030-b0163", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘After premising thus much, it would be a work of supererogation to add, that dust and ashes are for ever scattered", "sha256": "d1a19e6feb38718d4b67b9130d7508193c45ecc83bbb24800f9e0a88af3ea41a", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[35]/p[164]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u030-b0164", "tag": "p", "role": "dateline_or_signature", "text": "‘On

‘WILKINS MICAWBER.’", "sha256": "04b1c747f9c20720326f69daec9c50be928c6a64980a2575ea30b6145e4cd30f", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[35]/p[165]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_lines": ["‘On", "‘The", "‘Head", "‘Of", "‘WILKINS MICAWBER.’"], "source_class": "right"}, {"id": "en85-u030-b0165", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "Poor Traddles! I knew enough of Mr. Micawber by this time, to foresee that he might be expected to recover the blow; but my night’s rest was sorely distressed by thoughts of Traddles, and of the curate’s daughter, who was one of ten, down in Devonshire, and who was such a dear girl, and who would wait for Traddles (ominous praise!) until she was sixty, or any age that could be mentioned.", "sha256": "3f695cee84ec414671fb7c91889d1b92343ea71fd5d72f032b948e4ebb678094", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[35]/p[166]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}]}
